legend: Diffuse infiltration of a well-differentiated tumour is seen, surrounding and enveloping mammary ducts.
A vascular neoplasm demonstrates relatively bland cytomorphology but a diffusely infiltrative growth pattern, insinuating around individual adipocytes.
This vascular proliferation is composed of anastomosing channels lined by atypical endothelial cells with hyperchromatic nuclei, vesicular chromatin, and occasional nucleoli.
A well-differentiated tumour infiltrates and dissects the mammary lobules.
Medium-power view shows that a well-differentiated tumour infiltrates and dissects the mammary lobules.
The lesion is composed of well-formed vessels lined by flattened endothelial cells with minimal atypia.
Gross image of breast displaying a nodular lesion with ulceration of the surface.
The lesion shows vascular proliferation of anastomosing channels lined by atypical endothelial cells with hyperchromatic nuclei, vesicular chromatin and occasional nucleoli,HES stain.

Low grade angiosarcoma featuring an extensively permeative vascular proliferation dissecting through breast lobules and fibroadipose stroma. Endothelial cells show mild nuclear atypia. Haemorrhage is present.
Large pleomorphic cells form vascular channels with large area of central infarction.
